judgments.reason: The phrase 'a focal segment of small-bowel wall thickening' appears literally in the MR enterography findings and supports localization of the tumor to the small intestine.
The phrase 'an exophytic ileal mass' appears literally in the operative findings and directly supports small intestinal (ileal) anatomic localization.
The phrase 'lobulated mass arising from the small-intestinal wall' appears literally in the gross pathology description and supports the small intestine as the anatomic site.
